title: Apply teal-on-cream branding and regenerate the weekly clip
description:
## Requested result

Deploy the approved visual changes in **EffortlessSteven/e-balls only**. The README caption and restored 96px right-aligned logo placement are staged. The renderer, SVG, regenerated media and validation remain to be implemented before merge.

- Use cream `#f5f1e8` and teal `#156b76` (not the substitute colors in the earlier chat SVG). Teal title, dates, counts and footer on cream. IBM Plex Sans for primary text and IBM Plex Mono for data/metadata are the approved portable fallback to Satoshi/Geist Mono. Fetch official IBM/plex OFL assets directly in the implementation environment and retain their licenses/source hashes. Do not put font files or compiler binaries in media/evidence archives.
- Keep the upstream composition, seven chronological rows, the same preserved Steven portrait on each ball, fixed-portrait pixel sharing, counts and linear bounce behavior. Keep the legacy release-balls CLI appearance via an explicit theme. Audit canvas, text RGB blending, transparent portrait flattening, circular sprite edges, sparse downsampling, dirty rectangles and YUV chroma padding/parity so no white halos/stripes remain.
- Adapt `assets/logo.svg`: original rounded tile and three circles at cx 96/122/150, r74, opacity .1/.2/1; cream tile, teal circles, cream lowercase e centered in the front circle. Outline the IBM Plex Sans e as a vector path, not an SVG text element or embedded font. Title: e-balls.
- Preserve the README opening description and this **exact** caption: `*Top 7 perl-lsp days in the past week, rendered with \`since: 7d\`.*`. Put dates/MP4 on a separate line. No opening fork explanation or unrelated prose rewrite.
- Add the minimal real collector counterpart `--since 7d`: seven completed UTC days, compatible with pinned `--end`; reject explicit `--days`/`--start` conflicts. Test it and use it in the documented and CI pinned example. Do not invent a publishing action or change multi-repository collection/counting.
- Re-render the same pinned week at `31b87ee79b8fb55b6433bed7c1f1e4478443d61e`, 2026-10-04 inclusive through 2026-10-11 exclusive. Preserve the old white example untouched. Put the new theme under `examples/perl-lsp-2026-10-04-teal/`; point README GIF/MP4 there. Reuse the preserved original portrait. Keep actual source attribution. Expected daily counts remain 5773, 5691, 3809, 3292, 109, 4, 734 across 129 commits, not hardcoded into the collector.

## Acceptance

Actual rustfmt, release Clippy with warnings denied, Rust tests, both release binary builds and all Python/compiled-media tests. New palette, transparency, sprite-edge, YUV parity and since regressions. Actual MP4 1080x1080/60fps and GIF 480x480, 16 seconds; full decode, probes and sampled visual review. Keep compact real logs, source identities, theme/font manifest, checksums, preview and contact sheet with the media. No fake green checks.

Update only the About description if the execution environment has an authorized metadata capability: `Race occurrences of E in perl-lsp commit messages as a GIF and MP4.` Otherwise report the exact unsupported/permission error; do not change permissions or add a settings-sync workflow.

No upstream writes, no perl-lsp repo writes, no release or social posting. The supervisor owns review and merge.
